subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these 14 updated external GitHub Action revisions in workflows that mint credentials, publish artifacts, and upload security data?
rationale: The diff is mechanically scoped and preserves SHA pinning, but approving new third-party action commits for privileged workflows is a repository trust-boundary decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve updated action pins
options.body: Approve the reviewed supplier revisions after current-head workflow checks finish successfully.

options.title: Hold selected suppliers
options.body: Keep this PR open while the workflow/security owner separately reviews or excludes any action revision not yet accepted for privileged execution.

options.title: Close and regenerate later
options.body: Close this Dependabot batch if synchronized action upgrades are not desired, allowing a later reviewed update to propose current versions.

recommendation.title: Approve updated action pins
recommendation.body: Approve the reviewed supplier revisions after current-head workflow checks finish successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: The only supplied ownership signal is security-routing automation; it should route the human supplier-boundary decision to the repository’s workflow/security owner.
